proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ _ _ H _ _ α β hα
  refine ⟨LieModule.chainTopCoeff (α : H → K) β, LieModule.chainBotCoeff (α : H → K) β, fun n => ?_, LieAlgebra.IsKilling.apply_coroot_eq_cast α β⟩
  rw [LieAlgebra.IsKilling.rootSpace_zsmul_add_ne_bot_iff α β hα n]
  omega
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (L : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [LieAlgebra.IsKilling K L] (H : LieSubalgebra K L) [H.IsCartanSubalgebra] [LieModule.IsTriangularizable K H L] (α β : LieModule.Weight K H L), α.IsNonZero → ∃ p q : ℕ, (∀ n : ℤ, LieAlgebra.rootSpace H (n • (α : H → K) + β) ≠ ⊥ ↔ -(q : ℤ) ≤ n ∧ n ≤ p) ∧ β (LieAlgebra.IsKilling.coroot α) = ((q : ℤ) - (p : ℤ) : ℤ)
